texto: The days of the week and the months of the year are written in small Dutch: «maandag» (Monday), «vrijdag» (Friday), «zaterdag» (Saturday), «maart» (March). To indicate the date on which an event takes place, the «op»: «op maandag 12 maart» preposition is preceded (Monday, March 12).

frases.nl: En wanneer is de eerste toets?

bloques.pregunta: What is the preposition of a specific day or date in Dutch?

opciones.explicacion: «op» is used for days and dates («op maandag», «op 12 maart»).
«In» is reserved for isolated months or years («in maart», «in 2026»).
«Bij» expresses physical proximity or company («next to / at home of»).

bloques.pregunta: What date does Tom indicate for the start of the course?

opciones.explicacion: March 23 is the date of the first examination, not the beginning of the course.
Sara expressly clarifies that there is no teaching activity on Saturday.

bloques.pregunta: Complete to ask for the first test.

opciones.explicacion: «Datum» means date in general, not the test itself.
Although it means class, the dialogue specifically asks for «de eerste toets».

bloques.pregunta: What does Sara get from hearing Tom's answer?

opciones.texto: That the test is not held on Saturday.
opciones.explicacion: «Dus niet op zaterdag» confirms that it does not fall on Saturday but on Friday.

opciones.texto: That the course has been definitely cancelled
opciones.explicacion: Nothing is cancelled; it only shows what day there is no evidence.

opciones.texto: That the exam will last the whole weekend
opciones.explicacion: Sara checks that Saturday is free of examination.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the day of the week corresponding to the date of the examination.

opciones.explicacion: The exam is held on Friday («vrijdag»).
Monday March 12 is the beginning of the course.
Sara confirms that she doesn't exactly fall on Saturday.

intro: Read and interpret dates and days of the week to organize daily activities.
